min_gpa_host.notes: No incoming exchange GPA requirement is stated in CETYS Fact Sheet 2025 (85/100 GPA requirement on cetys.mx applies to outgoing CETYS students).

instruction_languages.notes: Primary instruction is Spanish; Mexicali and Tijuana campuses also offer 100% English 'Global Programs' in International Business and Industrial Engineering, plus selected English courses in Ensenada.

english_course_availability.notes: 100% English 'Global Programs' offered in International Business and Industrial Engineering (Mexicali & Tijuana) plus selected English courses at Ensenada.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Minimum CEFR B2 (upper intermediate) proficiency required for courses in English; proof of English or Spanish proficiency is required in the application (RHET 1020 waiver not mentioned).

host_language_requirement.value: Minimum CEFR B2 (upper intermediate) in Spanish for Spanish-taught courses, or CEFR B2 in English for English Global Programs.

fall_term_dates.value: AY2025 reference pattern: Arrival/pickup Jul 28-31; Orientation Aug 1; Semester (incl. exams) Aug 4 - Dec 10 (see https://www.cetys.mx/en/school-calendar/ by campus for 2026-27).
fall_term_dates.notes: 2026-27 dynamic campus calendars hosted at https://www.cetys.mx/en/school-calendar/.

spring_term_dates.value: AY2025 reference pattern: Arrival/pickup Jan 13-16; Orientation Jan 17; Semester (incl. exams) Jan 20 - Jun 3 (see https://www.cetys.mx/en/school-calendar/ by campus for 2026-27).
spring_term_dates.notes: 2026-27 dynamic campus calendars hosted at https://www.cetys.mx/en/school-calendar/.

tuition_model.notes: Fact Sheet p.3 states: 'Tuition Fees: None, if the home institution has an exchange agreement with CETYS.'

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Fact sheet p.4 explicitly publishes monthly living estimate directly in USD: 'Estimated costs per month: USD $600 (500-550 Euros)' (shared housing USD $250-$300 + utilities, meals USD $20/day, cafeteria lunch USD $5, bus USD $0.70).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 1 USD = 1.0 USD on 2026-11-15 (published directly in USD by CETYS); 5-month semester estimate = USD $600/month * 5 months = 3,000.00 USD (fact sheet also notes 500-550 EUR/month equivalent).

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Tuition fees waived under partner agreement. Health insurance (including COVID-19 coverage) is mandatory for all students; students must show proof prior to arrival or purchase insurance at CETYS upon arrival.

housing_availability.notes: Fact sheet p.4 states: 'There are no dormitories, facilities at CETYS. The international office will provide a list of options; however the students are free to select their own housing options.'

housing_notes.value: No on-campus dormitories; International Office supplies a list of off-campus housing options. Shared student housing estimated at USD $250-$300/month plus utilities.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: CETYS assists incoming exchange students in obtaining student visas when required; non-restricted nationalities staying <=180 days may enter under Mexico's FMM/visitor rules while restricted nationalities or >180-day stays require a consular Mexican student visa prior to arrival.

course_catalog_url.notes: Academic program lists are campus-specific; request syllabi from Ensenada (internacionales.ens@cetys.mx), Tijuana (internacionales.tij@cetys.mx), or Mexicali (internacionales.mxli@cetys.mx).

english_course_list_url.notes: 100% English Global Programs at Mexicali/Tijuana also include Industrial Engineering (https://www.cetys.mx/en/academic-programs/undergraduate-programs/industrial-engineering/); Ensenada English list maintained via Google Doc in Fact Sheet p.2.

credit_system_and_load.value: Up to 5 courses per semester; 1 CETYS course = 8 credits (64 contact hours over 16 weeks, 4 hours/week).

course_restrictions_note.value: Course availability depends on selected campus (Mexicali, Tijuana, or Ensenada); English Global Programs are only on Mexicali/Tijuana, while Spanish courses for non-credit are offered at Ensenada.

value: Letter of recommendation from home faculty member
Proof of Spanish or English language proficiency (CEFR B2)

city_tier.notes: Agreement covers three Baja California campuses (Mexicali, Tijuana, Ensenada); no single city_tier applies across Excel city 'Baja'.

campus_type.notes: Three campuses across Baja California: Mexicali, Tijuana, and Ensenada International Campus.

international_support_services.value: Free airport pickup from Mexicali, Tijuana, or San Diego (US) airports; orientation day; non-credit Spanish language courses and Buddy Program at Ensenada International Campus.
international_support_services.notes: Orientation and campus coordinator contacts listed on p.1-2.

nomination_deadlines.value: AY2025 pattern: Spring nomination Sep 1 - Nov 1 / application Nov 15; Fall nomination Mar 1 - May 15 / application May 30.
